selected_script.angle: Preventing door-blocking rug bunching and corner curling using thin flat L-shaped grippers
selected_script.hook: POV of opening a door that jams on a curled, sliding rug corner

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 realistic handheld phone-shot style TikTok ad video. Timeline: 0-3s Pain conflict: POV opening a wooden door that jams and bunches up a curled area rug corner on a light oak floor. 3-6s Solution: A hand applies a thin matte black flat L-shaped sticker (exactly 90-degree corner, clipped tips, flat polymer profile, no logos) to the underside corner of the rug and presses it down flat. 6-10s Fast-cut scene 1: The door swings wide open smoothly over the completely flat, unmoving rug. Product must stay flat, matte black, ultra-thin, no packaging patterns or temporary blue text.

Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 realistic handheld phone-shot style TikTok ad video continuing the previous segment. Timeline: 0-4s Fast-cut scene 2: A foot steps firmly on a dining room rug corner on hardwood floor, rug stays completely still. 4-8s Fast-cut scene 3: Close-up showing a rug corner lifted slightly to reveal the ultra-thin, flat matte black L-shaped sticker underneath, then laid back down perfectly flush. 8-10s CTA: Short text on screen reading 'Keep your rugs flat and secure.' Ensure identical product color, matte black material, L-shape, flat profile, and oak floor style. No visible logos or temporary blue prints.
